text: 金十期货11月6日讯，11月6日，中国证监会发布通知，同意广州期货交易所氢氧化锂期货和期权注册。上市氢氧化锂期货和期权，是期货市场持续建设完善品种体系、增强服务绿色发展金融支撑的具体举措。上市氢氧化锂期货和期权，是期货市场持续建设完善品种体系、增强服务绿色发展金融支撑的具体举措。广期所相关负责人表示，下一步，广期所将在中国证监会指导下，扎实做好氢氧化锂期货和期权上市各项准备工作，保障氢氧化锂期货和期权的平稳推出和稳健运行。
text_en: Jinshi Futures, November 6: On November 6, the CSRC issued a notice approving the registration of lithium hydroxide futures and options on the Guangzhou Futures Exchange. Listing lithium hydroxide futures and options is a concrete measure for the futures market to continue building and improving its product system and enhance financial support for green development. Listing lithium hydroxide futures and options is a concrete measure for the futures market to continue building and improving its product system and enhance financial support for green development. A relevant official of the Guangzhou Futures Exchange said that next, under the guidance of the CSRC, the exchange will solidly carry out preparations for the listing of lithium hydroxide futures and options and ensure their smooth launch and stable operation.
